title: Joint behavioral decoding and neural prediction from full spatial imaging fields
scientific_question: Can spatially structured neural dynamics jointly improve behavioral prediction and neural reconstruction in the complete published widefield and fUS benchmarks?

paired_access_conditions.A: Paper and sufficient scientific specification plus identical complete authorized data and train/dev labels; no official implementation.
paired_access_conditions.B: The same paper/specification/data and role information plus pinned official code. Missing essential method specification is a construction defect, not an A-arm model failure.
paired_access_conditions.parity: Equal execution, tuning and compute budgets; same complete held cases and metric. Public event schedules and paper-provided information remain equally available. Code/model/checkpoint exposure and contamination are audited.
paired_access_conditions.outcomes: Separate historical reproduction from prospective improvement. Preserve original test-selection/leakage if reproducing it, label it, and never substitute a corrected split without a distinct prospective result. Narrative cannot replace numeric artifacts.

paper.title: Dynamical Modeling of Behaviorally Relevant Spatiotemporal Patterns in Neural Imaging Data

data.license: Unresolved in retained landing-page metadata; no open license inferred from public links.
data.access: Data description and storage-link documents public; deposit-request form alone staff-restricted. Exact full-array access/version remains to qualify.
data.representation: Full reconstructed/cropped 128x128 calcium fields with synchronized behavior; compressed spatial/temporal factors may be used only if they exactly reconstruct the specified model input.

data.access: Open metadata, noncommercial-use restriction; external benchmark distribution/use rights need review.
data.representation: 2 Hz Power Doppler fields and session metadata in fUS_BMI_Data.zip; no ultrasound RF acquisition needed.

official_code.license: USC educational/research/nonprofit permission; commercial use requires separate permission.
official_code.availability: Pinned code/README/license and tutorial verified; tutorial uses placeholder random data, not evidence of a complete real-data loader.
official_code.publication_identity: Current pinned commit, not a frozen paper environment.

complete_scope: Both complete widefield assays plus every source-defined fUS session/condition used for Tables 2–3, retaining spatial fields and all behavioral channels. No replacing the model's image input with published embeddings or an arbitrary ROI subset.

outputs: Complete Table 2 behavioral MSE/F1 and neural MSE
Complete Table 3 fUS classification accuracy and neural MSE
baselines: CEBRA/TNDM as specified in the paper
reference.panel: Tables 2–3 and Appendix A.4 preprocessing; final exact baseline grid requires source audit.

prospective_improvement.endpoint: Improve behavior prediction on held sessions without degrading neural reconstruction under a frozen Pareto rule; calibrated fUS directional probabilities and all-channel widefield error.
prospective_improvement.heldout_unit: Whole trials for historical reproduction; sessions/animals for prospective transfer. Temporal purge around any filtering/context boundary.
controls: Spatially permuted fields at matched pixel count
No held labels in behavior-prioritized training
Report causal preprocessing separately from any noncausal reproduction

resources.basis: Full spatial models across 5/10 folds and baseline/ablation grids. Widefield cropped float32 arrays alone are roughly several GB; 34.25 GB fUS archive is observed, total expansion unknown.

remaining_gates: CSHL data license and exact two assay/session identities
Actual preprocessing implementation beyond placeholder tutorial
Frozen full spatial model/baseline grid and train-only transform policy
overlap: Shared CSHL family with Rastermap; existing fUS NEURAL-SCOPE-20261114-FUS-DIRECTION cites Caltech10.22002/p5jan-02r60 and Zenodo16732610, whereas this candidate cites pa710-cdn95. Same modality/lab is not proved same acquisition. New central claim is joint spatial representation/dynamics across complete calcium and ultrasound assays.
participant_inputs: Full source-defined cropped128x128 widefield calcium fields with aligned behavior (248+412 trials) and all source-defined fUS sessions/conditions with2Hz Power Doppler fields; compressed factors only if exact input reconstruction is established.

machine_output.predictions: All held trial/time/channel behavior predictions and neural field predictions; calibrated fUS direction class probabilities, with exact session and pixel/channel masks.
machine_output.tables: Full Tables2–3 and attention/two-stage/convolution ablation rows, every original fold/session and comparator, grouped uncertainty and compute.
machine_output.artifacts: Frozen training/config/input reconstruction, complete census and causal/noncausal preprocessing profile.

scoring: Published behavior MSE/F1, neural MSE and fUS classification accuracy on identical held support. Prospective held-session behavior improvement requires frozen neural-reconstruction noninferiority/Pareto rule; exact margins and grid remain unchosen.
protected_split: Original whole-trial reproduction, then separately protected whole-session/animal transfer with temporal purge covering filters/context. TRAIN-only normalization; no held behavior in prioritized fitting.
comparators: SBIND versus full paper DPAD/CEBRA/TNDM grid and attention/two-stage/convolution ablations; stimulus/time/condition and movement priors and spatial-field permutations.
distinctness: Joint spatiotemporal behavioral/neural modeling is distinct from Rastermap sorting even if acquisitions overlap. Both imaging modalities remain one central method task, not two task counts.

publication_context.historical_administrative_text: Proposal-era counts, recommendations and source-phase observations in inherited fields are historical. The package registry records the applied 233-draft programme state; no authentic readiness is inferred.
publication_context.private_locator_policy: Null path fields identify private construction evidence that is not shipped or dereferenced. Original byte/hash pins are provenance references, not public validation certificates or dependency availability.
